style: stylized 3D animated comedy, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: a wiry female spotted hyena office worker, big bright cobalt-blue shirt, wide tangerine-orange climbing harness; sloped back, mane bristles on every jerk; dry, never smiles
second_characters: a small rat boss in a purple vest
props: red rope from her harness over a big pulley to a magenta open lift cage; two empty loops on the rope by her shoulder; in the cage three desks, two empty chairs; two photo-badge jackets over the rat's shoulder; the rat's briefcase with big orange scissors clipped on; three envelopes (the rat's)
environment: tall freight lift shaft, plain mint-green brick walls, big white floor numbers 1 2 3, bright open floor doors, yellow-striped floor
lighting: bright, warm key on her face, hot-pink rim left, cyan rim right; blue shirt and orange harness bright in every shot

light_events.event: white light blasts from the floor 3 doors

motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; the hyena fills half the frame, except the close-up beats; she moves her whole body

audio.delivery: dry flat adult female voice, sarcastic, tired; the hyena speaks
sfx: loudest: rope jerk, paws slam wall 8.2

timeline.a: from the first frame, already hanging flat on the rope, paws braced on the wall, the hyena strains, two empty loops swing at her shoulder; the rat sits high in the cage
timeline.c: camera hurls itself up the rope to the cage

timeline.a: mouth free and talking, she leaps up the wall, grabs the rope higher, drops with all her weight; the cage jerks up a floor, the rat bounces
timeline.c: camera free-falls with her, then flies up

timeline.a: the rat flicks one envelope down the shaft, stuffs two in his vest; below, she swings out from the wall, jaws up
timeline.c: camera swings overhead, top-down, envelopes in foreground

timeline.a: mouth free and talking, she twists her whole body on the rope, reaching with open jaws for the falling envelope
timeline.c: camera tumbles down after the envelope

timeline.a: at 4.00 she snaps the envelope in her teeth; her shoulders shake in a nervous laugh; she tucks it under her harness strap
timeline.c: camera dives into her face, close-up

timeline.a: the rat snips the straps of the two empty chairs with the orange scissors and kicks them out
timeline.c: camera plunges into the blades, close-up

timeline.a: mouth free and talking, she kicks off the wall and swings across the shaft; two chairs whistle down past her and smash on the floor
timeline.c: camera flies up from the floor, chair leg in foreground

timeline.a: the cage slams the top; the rope flings her up to the floor 3 doors, nose to nose with the rat
timeline.c: camera arcs round her from below

timeline.a: the rat takes the two badge jackets off his shoulder, hangs them on the two empty loops; she kicks and spins under the loops
timeline.c: camera whips round to his paws

timeline.a: the jackets' weight yanks her down a floor; she slams into the wall on all fours, mane up, hanging between the two jackets, mouth free and talking
timeline.c: camera hurls itself at the badges, close-up

timeline.a: silent; at the pulley the rat sets the open orange scissors on her red rope; below she freezes
timeline.c: camera flies up the rope onto the blades, close-up

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, humans
